summary: Student Web Portal (Next.js website port 3001) — full end-to-end validation. Wrote pytest suite (24 tests) covering: HTTP-only cookie session auth (login/register/logout), middleware protection for /portal/* with 307 -> /login?next=..., all portal SSR pages (dashboard, library, course detail, watch, tests, profile), progress proxy (auth + unauth), header auth-awareness, website regression, and backend spot-checks. 24/24 passed. Additionally ran a browser UI journey via Playwright: filled login form, navigated to dashboard, watch page (verified <video>, sidebar highlight of 'Introduction to Number System', Next lecture button), course detail (5 subjects / 600 lectures / curriculum tree), library, profile, and sign-out flow — all render and redirect correctly. Confirmed avn_session cookie is HttpOnly (document.cookie is empty). Confirmed JWT never appears in any HTML response body. No regressions detected on the public website.

issues: React hydration mismatch warning on login/register inputs (caret-color: transparent + style ordering) logged in console. Does not block functionality but is a legitimate SSR/CSR style diff — likely from inline style objects being processed differently by the client. Consider extracting the input style to a CSS class or wrapping styles in useEffect.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the hydration-mismatch warning on the login/register forms (caret-color: transparent + border/padding style ordering). This is a console-warning-only issue and does not block the flow; recommend refactoring inline styles on <input> to a CSS class or wrapping style overrides so SSR and CSR produce identical style objects.
critical_code_review_comments: Session security is well-implemented: JWT is stored server-side in HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax cookie; document.cookie verified empty; client-side progress calls go through /api/session/progress proxy which attaches the token server-side. No token leakage in HTML output.
Middleware correctly guards /portal/:path* and includes ?next= for redirect chain.
Logout route sensibly branches on Accept header (form submit -> 303 redirect to /, JSON fetch -> {ok:true}); good UX.
Register route's error passthrough returns backend Pydantic detail as a stringified JSON — consider parsing the array to a user-friendly message (e.g. first .msg).
authFetch uses cache: 'no-store' — correct for personalized data. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded test@avision.com / Test@123 and pre-seeded vc-banking-2026 course + entitlement. Registration test creates disposable TEST_ users each run (backend cleanup not needed for this iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal test suite lives at /app/website/tests/test_portal_flow.py — 24 tests, ~4s runtime. Uses WEB_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:3001) and API_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:8001). Register test requires 10-digit Indian mobile format (backend Pydantic validator rejects '+91' prefix). Backend normalizes email to lowercase — always compare case-insensitively. To run: `python -m pytest /app/website/tests/test_portal_flow.py -v`.
